_om: Bossy: the cards with the players' names. {a}, {b} and {c} become three different players. A card is a text (a task) or { t, type, slutt }. type: alle (everyone), duell, kategori, valg (always with a choice without drinking), regel (lasts a few cards; slutt is the card that ends it), pek (point). Small sips only, never more than three.

kort: {a}, hand out two sips to whoever you think has travelled furthest from home.

kort.t: Everyone who has fallen asleep on the bus and missed their stop takes a sip.
{a} and {b}: Rock, paper, scissors! The loser takes a sip.
Things you find in a fridge. {a} starts, then it goes round. Whoever gets stuck takes a sip.
{a}, describe your best holiday in ten seconds – or take a sip.

kort: {a}, give a sip to the last person who sent you a message.

kort.t: Everyone who has been on a ferry to France takes a sip.
Nobody may say ‘yes’ or ‘no’. Whoever slips up takes a sip.
kort.slutt: You can say ‘yes’ and ‘no’ again. What a relief!

kort.t: Count to three and point at whoever loses their keys most often. Whoever gets the most fingers hands out two sips.

kort: {a}, say something nice about {b}. Then the two of you say cheers.
{a} and {b} swap seats. Cheers to the new neighbours!

kort.t: Everyone wearing something black takes a sip.
{a}, sing a line from the song you sing in the shower – or take two sips.

kort: {a}, hand out three sips. You decide how.

kort.t: {a} and {b}: The first to point at something red in the room hands out two sips.
British towns and cities. {a} starts. Whoever gets stuck or repeats one takes a sip.

kort: {a}, say cheers to the person on your right and tell them what you like best about them.

kort.t: Everyone with a birthday between October and March takes a sip.
{a} is royalty. Everyone says ‘Your Majesty’ before speaking to {a}. Whoever forgets takes a sip.
kort.slutt: {a} hands back the crown. No more ‘Your Majesty’.

kort: {a}, name everyone here in five seconds. If you can, hand out three sips. If not, take one.
{a}, guess how many brothers and sisters {b} has. Right: hand out two sips. Wrong: take one.

kort.t: Everyone with under 20 per cent battery takes a sip – and finds a charger.

kort: {a}, guess {b}'s favourite food. Right: {b} takes a sip. Wrong: you take one.
{a}, make a toast to tonight. Everyone raises their glass.

kort.t: Count to three and point at whoever would win a cooking contest. Whoever gets the most fingers hands out two sips.

kort: {a}, make an animal noise. Whoever guesses the animal hands out a sip.

kort.t: Everyone who has sent a message to the wrong person takes a sip.
Things that are yellow. {a} starts. Whoever gets stuck takes a sip.
{a} and {b} are drinking buddies. When one takes a sip, so does the other.
kort.slutt: {a} and {b} are no longer drinking buddies. Cheers to teamwork!

kort: {a}, tell a joke. If anyone laughs, hand out two sips. If nobody does, laugh at it yourself – and take a sip.
Cheers to {a}! Everyone says one thing they like about {a}.

kort.t: {a} and {b}: Thumb war! The loser takes a sip.

kort: {a}, point at whoever you think has the most unread emails. Right: they take a sip. Wrong: you take one.

kort.t: Everyone who has watched the sunrise this year takes a sip.

kort: {a}, hand out two sips to whoever arrived last tonight.
{a}, name three things in your pocket or bag – without looking. All right: hand out three sips. Otherwise, take one.
{a}, hand out three sips to three different people.

kort.t: Everyone who has danced on a table takes a sip.
Nobody may point. Whoever points takes a sip.
kort.slutt: Pointing is allowed again. Point at someone you love.

kort.t: Before every sip you must say ‘Cheers to {a}!’. If you forget, stand up and say it out loud.
kort.slutt: {a} is no longer the star of the night. No more ‘Cheers to {a}!’.

kort: {a}, who here would you take to a desert island? The two of you say cheers.

kort.t: Excuses for being late. {a} starts. Whoever gets stuck takes a sip.
{a} and {b}: Staring contest! The first to blink or laugh takes a sip.
{a}, show us your best dance move for five seconds – or take two sips.
Count to three and point at whoever will be last to leave tonight. Whoever gets the most fingers hands out three sips.
Everyone who has fallen asleep at a party takes a sip.

kort: {a}, say a word. {b} says a word that rhymes, then it goes round. Whoever gets stuck takes a sip.

kort.t: {a}, tell us about the silliest thing you have ever bought – or take two sips.
{a} is the question master. Anyone who answers a question from {a} takes a sip.
kort.slutt: {a} is no longer the question master. Ask away!

kort: {a}, name five countries beginning with B – in ten seconds. If you can, hand out two sips.
{a}, give {b} a nickname for the rest of the night. It has to be a kind one!
{a} counts down from three. On zero, everyone touches their nose. The last one takes a sip.
{a}, if you were an animal, what would you be? If {b} agrees, hand out a sip. If not, take one.

kort.t: Things you pack for a weekend in a caravan. {a} starts. Whoever gets stuck takes a sip.
Everyone must drink with their left hand. Whoever uses their right takes a sip.
kort.slutt: Right hands are allowed again. The left-handers cheer quietly.

kort.t: Everyone who has sent a message after midnight and regretted it takes a sip.
{a} and {b}: Who can do the most squats in ten seconds? The winner hands out two sips. If you'd rather not, just say cheers.
{a}, sing the chorus of a Christmas song – whatever month it is. Or take two sips.

kort: {a}, find something in the room that starts with the same letter as your name. Do it in five seconds and hand out two sips.

kort.t: Count to three and point at whoever is most likely to be famous one day. Whoever gets the most fingers gives a short thank-you speech.

kort: {a}, say one kind thing about {b} that {b} doesn't know you've noticed.
{a}, you're the DJ! Pick the next song. Everyone who doesn't sing along to the chorus takes a sip.
{a}, who here has the best smile? Give them two sips to hand out.

kort.t: {a} and {b}: Whoever has the most photos on their phone hands out three sips.
Nobody may say anyone's name. Whoever says a name takes a sip.
kort.slutt: Names are allowed again. Say the name of someone you like!

kort.t: Everyone who has lost a shoe at a party takes a sip.

kort: Whoever has the longest first name hands out two sips. {a} counts the letters.

kort.t: {a}, tell us about the strangest job you've ever had – or take a sip.

kort: {a} and {b} swap names until the next card. Whoever gets it wrong takes a sip.

kort.t: Things you could say both at the beach and in a church. {a} starts. Whoever gets stuck takes a sip.
{a}, {b} and {c}: Whoever went to the cinema most recently hands out two sips.
{a}, speak in a different accent until the next card – or take two sips.
{a}, do ten squats – or take two sips.
{a}, give an acceptance speech as if you'd just won a big award – or take two sips.
{a}, stand as still as a statue until the next card – or take two sips.
{a}, commentate on what's happening in the room like a football commentator for 20 seconds – or take two sips.
{a}, say the alphabet backwards from J – or take a sip.
{a}, act out an animal until someone guesses it – or take two sips.
{a}, rap four lines about {b} – kind words only! Or take two sips.
{a}, say one nice thing to each of the others – or take three sips.
{a}, show the last emoji you sent and explain why – or take a sip.
{a}, balance a cushion on your head until the next card – or take two sips.
{a}, make a ten-second advert for your drink – or take two sips.
{a}, say ‘Red lorry, yellow lorry’ five times fast – or take a sip.
{a}, sing ‘Happy Birthday’ to {b} – birthday or not. Or take two sips.
{a}, the others choose a pose you must hold until the next card – or take two sips.
{a}, tell a story where every word starts with S – for ten seconds. Or take a sip.

kort: {a}, try to lick your elbow. If you manage it, hand out three sips. If you tried, hand out one.

kort.t: {a}, do your best robot dance for ten seconds – or take two sips.
{a}, pay a compliment to everyone wearing something blue – or take a sip.
{a}, show the last photo you took of food – or take a sip.
{a}, make the sound of a rocket taking off – or take a sip.

kort: {a}, whisper a secret word to {b}. {b} must get {c} to say it before the next card – without saying it. If {b} manages it, {b} hands out two sips.

kort.t: {a}, describe {b} with three lovely words – or take two sips.
{a}, speak only in questions until the next card – or take two sips.
{a} and {b}: Invent a secret handshake together – or take a sip each.

kort: {a}, hum a song. Whoever guesses it first hands out two sips.

kort.t: {a}, be a weather presenter and give the forecast for the rest of the night – or take two sips.
{a}, sit on the floor until the next card – or take a sip.
{a}, say a sentence where every word is one letter longer than the one before – or take a sip.
{a}, be a tour guide and show {b} round the room for 20 seconds – or take two sips.
{a}, greet everyone as if they were old friends you haven't seen for ten years – or take two sips.
{a}, say ‘thank you’ in three languages – or take a sip.

kort: {a}, try your best chat-up line on {b} – just for fun. If {b} laughs, hand out two sips.

kort.t: Count to three and point at whoever has the nicest smile. Whoever gets the most fingers hands out three sips.
{a}, describe your dream date in ten seconds – or take two sips.
Everyone who has been on a date this year takes a sip.

kort: {a}, wink at {b}. If {b} keeps a straight face, {b} hands out two sips.
{a}, read the next card in your most seductive voice.

kort.t: {a} and {b}: Look each other in the eye. The first to laugh takes a sip.
{a}, tell us about your strangest date – or take two sips.
Everyone who has sent a heart to the wrong person takes a sip.
{a}, pay {b} a compliment that makes {b} blush – or take two sips.
Count to three and point at the biggest romantic here. Whoever gets the most fingers picks the next song.
{a}, say the most romantic sentence you can – to a chair. Or take a sip.
Everyone who has had a holiday romance takes a sip.
{a}, what was the first thing you noticed about {b}? Say it – or take two sips.

{a}, sing three lines of a love song to {b} – or take two sips.
Count to three and point at whoever would send the sweetest messages. Whoever gets the most fingers hands out two sips.
{a}, tell us the most romantic thing you've ever done for someone – or take two sips.
{a}, write a four-line love poem for {b} – sweet and silly. Or take two sips.
Everyone who is single hands out a sip each. Cheers to freedom!
Everyone in a relationship says cheers to their partner – even if they're not here.

kort: {a}, who here would you take on a long hike? The two of you say cheers.

kort.t: {a}, what's the best chat-up line anyone has tried on you? Tell us – or take a sip.

finale: Last card! {a} gives a short speech for the crew. Everyone says cheers – and has a glass of water afterwards.
Last card! Everyone says cheers to their neighbour and thanks for tonight.
Last card! {a} and {b} choose the last song of the night. Cheers to the crew!
